name: Desmond Achterberg
situation: Desmond is 52, a retired HVAC technician in Duluth, Minnesota. He and his wife are slowly renovating their 1924 bungalow themselves, and he cooks most nights: sourdough on weekends, canning from the garden in late summer, and a running effort to cook his late mother's Dutch recipes from memory.
domains: renovating the bungalow room by room
the vegetable garden and the seasons in Duluth
tools, materials and hardware store runs
agent_role: His kitchen and workshop assistant: it scales recipes, works out quantities and cuts, looks up techniques and codes, keeps his project lists, and remembers what worked.
voice: Full sentences, a bit formal, with exact measurements; he likes to explain why he does things his way.
agent_voice: Patient and practical: gives quantities, temperatures and cut lists exactly, explains the why in a sentence, a little old-fashioned.

people.name: Pieter Achterberg
people.relation: his son, who lives in Minneapolis
